name: hud
notes: Shown while a run is under way. A screen shows what the game keeps: {MODULE.KEY} is a value a module set with Cx::set_state (a map with msg and args is a line of the string tables); {game.score} the score the game file names; {setting.NAME} a setting. A button's action that the engine does not know (anything but start, pause, resume, title, open:, close, back, goto:, set:, step:, cycle:, save:, load:, quit) reaches the modules as the event ui with that action.
